issue_context.body:

comments:
Hey there @emontnemery, mind taking a look at this issue as it has been labeled with an integration (`mqtt`) you are listed as a [code owner](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/blob/dev/CODEOWNERS#L327) for? Thanks!
<sub><sup>(message by CodeOwnersMention)</sup></sub>

Related to  #57479. The availability topic should accept a list. The list item should be a dict. A check should be added to ensure the list item is a dict(), add a warning to the log if something else is provided.

@piio have you modified the log out of privacy concerns or do the messages really include stuff like:
`homeassistant/binary_sensor/{dev}/{id}/config` and `{"avty":{"topic":"supla/{id}/devices/{dev}/channels/{channel}/state/connected"`
I modified this data to not expose all details about devices
OK, that's fine, but **please mention that you've done that**!

Hi, I have manually implemented change from #58684 and it looks that this problem is fixed.
Thanks.
